problem: UAOS already owns cognition, root-scope, evolution and problem-closure semantics, but ChatGPT conversational execution and UAOS-managed runtimes did not share one finalization seam that composes those owners and prevents a candidate final response from being emitted while actionable work or required evidence remains.

competing_hypotheses.support: Repeated mistakes can look like insufficient architecture/SOP knowledge.
competing_hypotheses.falsification: The repository already contains a single canonical cognition kernel, executable root-scope admission, typed evolution disposition and fail-closed problem closure; the repeated escapes occurred after those mechanisms existed.

competing_hypotheses.support: Rolling observations, records and repeated continuation turns created visible governance overhead and at times made the user a workflow clock.
competing_hypotheses.falsification: Reducing prose alone would not make a final response fail closed when executable work or evidence is still missing.

competing_hypotheses.support: Cognition, problem closure and session adherence are separately executable, but before this candidate no runtime function composed them into one pre-emit admission decision and no OpenAI Agents adapter attached that decision as an output guardrail.
competing_hypotheses.falsification: The selected repair reuses the existing owners instead of creating a new cognition or control plane, so it can be tested directly.

competing_hypotheses.support: Custom Instructions apply across ChatGPT conversations and are useful for stable bootstrap behavior.
competing_hypotheses.falsification: OpenAI documents Custom Instructions as instructions supplied to ChatGPT and states there is no Custom Instructions API; this does not establish an application-controlled pre-send validator.

competing_hypotheses.support: OpenAI Agents SDK output guardrails run on final agent output and a triggered tripwire raises OutputGuardrailTripwireTriggered, allowing a controlled application path to halt final output.
competing_hypotheses.falsification: The guarantee applies only to runs that actually attach the guardrail and must not be projected onto the ChatGPT product host.

external_evidence: OpenAI Help Center: Custom Instructions apply across chats, are user-editable instructions, and have no Custom Instructions API.
OpenAI Agents SDK: output guardrails validate final agent output; a triggered tripwire halts the run with OutputGuardrailTripwireTriggered.

candidate_change.mechanism: Compose existing problem closure and session adherence at a single runtime finalization seam; block finalization when actionable work remains without user input, problem closure is not terminal, cognition/evolution evidence is missing, or final report consistency fails. Controlled OpenAI Agents runs may attach the same gate as a blocking output guardrail.
candidate_change.anti_bloat: No second cognition state machine, no second controller, no new progress-report field, and no duplicated full policy in Custom Instructions.

assurance_boundary: This candidate can make UAOS-controlled runtime paths fail closed. It does not claim that the ChatGPT product host invokes repository Python before every native chat response.
verification_required: problem closure plus cognition/evolution evidence admission
